what_this_is: what identifies the GLORYxR arm: the revision of an unpublished tool, the digests of unpublished weights, and the permission under which both are used here

tool.name: GLORYxR
tool.what_unpublished_means_here: there is no release, no DOI and no paper for this tool, so the revision above is what identifies it; its first author states it remains unpublished
tool.read_from: the checkout, not typed into this file

why_this_provider: the one the published columns took; its docstring states predictions will closely follow those of the original GLORYx implementation

identical_dumps.what_the_author_said: that the models are identical, both classes being simply Phase 1 reactions that should be scored the same, and that this is inelegant and wasteful of disk space and model size but intended for the current version
identical_dumps.why_this_is_recorded: anyone who hashes these weights will find the duplicate; without the author's statement beside the measurement a reader would reasonably suspect this work of having loaded the same file twice by mistake

where_the_dumps_live: nowhere permanent. They are not distributed with the package and were supplied privately for this work, so on this machine they exist only under a session scratchpad. The digests above are what will identify them after that path is gone, and what will let anyone check a future deposit is the same weights

permission.scope: inclusion of GLORYxR in this work as a pre-publication version, and use of the privately supplied model dumps to run it

conditions.condition: the paper says this is a pre-publication version
the paper states that GLORYxR succeeds GLORYx

permission.availability_note: its author states an intention to deposit the model checkpoints under an academic licence, which would remove the availability limitation. That has not happened at the time of writing and nothing here anticipates it: the limitation stands as recorded until a deposit exists
permission.recorded_not_quoted: the correspondence itself is private and is not reproduced here or in the manuscript; what is recorded is the substance a reader needs, which is that permission was given and on what terms
